Amit Saharan, FRM

+91- 7827238199 | amitsaharan07.05@gmail.com| Bangalore EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

Experienced Lead Business Analyst with 15+ years in IT, including 8+ years specializing in Asset Management, Capital Markets, Client Onboarding, Client Servicing, and Risk Management. Proven expertise in business transformation, process optimization, system integration, and delivering enterprise investment platforms. • Strong track record of delivering large-scale enterprise platforms by managing end-to-end requirements lifecycle and collaborating with cross-functional teams • Deep domain expertise in Equity, Fixed Income and Derivatives (Futures, Options, Swaps), with experience supporting investment strategy and reconciliation platforms • Proven ability to bridge business and technology by translating complex requirements into actionable deliverables • Skilled in Agile methodologies including backlog management, epics, user stories, sprint planning, and UAT coordination • Proficient in SQL, JIRA, Confluence, Visio, and data analysis to drive insights and decision-making

SKILLS

Business Analysis

Requirement Gathering & Analysis | Requirement Documentation | Stakeholder Management | Backlog Grooming | Epics & User Stories | Use Cases | UAT |Sprint Planning | Test Planning | Functional Testing

Domain Expertise

Capital Markets | Fixed Income | Derivatives (Futures, Options, Swaps) | Portfolio Management | Risk Management | Asset Management | Equity | Mutual funds | Hedge Funds

Tools & Technologies

SQL | JIRA | Confluence | MS Visio | Excel | HP ALM | Unix | XML, FpLM | Co-pilot | GitHub Copilot and MCP | Postman | Swagger

Methodologies

Scaled Agile and Agile | Scrum | Waterfall

EXPERIENCE

Lead Business Analyst Publicis Sapient Bangalore Roles and Responsibilities:

Feb 2023 - Present

Working on WINS (Wellington Investment Strategy), a multi-year enterprise initiative supporting firmwide investment strategy

capabilities

Partnered with Client Onboarding and Client Servicing teams to gather business requirements and enhance end-to-end client

lifecycle processes across the WINS investment platform.

Worked closely with Operations, Client Servicing, Portfolio Management, and Technology teams to support onboarding of new

institutional clients and improve client servicing workflows.

Collaborated with cross-functional teams to streamline client onboarding, account setup, and investment strategy processes,

ensuring regulatory and operational compliance.

Collaborating with stakeholders to identify, define, and document business and functional requirements

Managing product backlog, epics, and user stories aligned with Agile delivery

Defining use cases and acceptance criteria for development teams

Supporting QA teams in test case creation and ensuring alignment with requirements

Driving UAT and sprint demos through business validation

Providing functional support for production issues

Performing data analysis using SQL

Key Achievements:

Streamlined reconciliation processes for WINS platform, significantly reducing false breaks and improving operational accuracy

Identified and resolved critical system issues, reducing manual reconciliation effort and saving ~8 hours per day for the BA team

Designed and implemented a Recon Dashboard, enabling real-time monitoring and successfully transitioning reconciliation

ownership to Operations team

Enabled seamless delivery of a firmwide investment strategy platform by aligning cross-functional stakeholders across business

and technology

Lead Business Analyst Tata Consultancy Services

Jul 2021 - Feb 2023

Gurgaon

Roles and Responsibilities:

Led UAT for migration from TLM 2.7 to Recs Premium reconciliation platform

Coordinated testing across global stakeholders (Japan, Singapore, India, UK)

Created and managed user stories, use cases, and backlog refinement

Facilitated sprint planning and alignment between business and QA teams

Reviewed UAT test cases, defects, and QA deliverables

Key Achievements:

Successfully managed UAT across multiple geographies and stakeholders, ensuring smooth coordination and timely execution

Delivered a high-quality production release with zero critical defects post go-live

Accelerated UAT cycles by proactively defining test scenarios and improving business validation readiness

Senior Business Analyst IHS Markit

Jul 2019 - Jul 2021 Gurgaon

Roles and Responsibilities:

Worked on TradeServ platform for credit and FX trade confirmation, clearing, and regulatory reporting

Gathered and documented functional requirements and supported implementation

Assisted in defect resolution and change request management

Supported UAT and business validation processes

Key Achievements:

Contributed to modernization of trade processing platform, improving operational efficiency and system reliability

QA/BA Sapient Consulting

Mar 2016 - Mar 2019

Gurgaon

Roles and Responsibilities:

Worked on Strategy Blotter tool used by portfolio managers for trade execution and P&L tracking

Created use cases, test cases, and refined user stories

Managed sprint planning, test planning, and gap analysis

Supported development teams in resolving defects and change requests

Provided functional support for production issues

Key Achievements:

Supported delivery of a critical trading platform used by global bond teams, ensuring stability and performance

Improved testing and requirement processes, leading to reduction in production issues and enhanced release quality
